captions.detailed: This 3D model consists of two separate rectangular trays designed to hold machine tool collets. One tray is significantly taller than the other, representing the main base holder, while the shorter tray serves as a matching top cover. Both components feature a 2x5 grid of circular, tapered pocket holes to securely nest individual collets.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric collet holder and optional top cover for ER-style collets. The user should be able to specify the number of rows and columns, select standard ER collet sizes (such as ER16), toggle between an open or closed bottom, and optionally generate a matching top cover tray.
captions.factory: The script uses a nested loop to position the collet pockets along a grid defined by 'rows' and 'columns'. Each pocket is created by subtracting a tapered 'cylinder' (representing the ER collet angle) from a rectangular 'cube' using the 'difference' operator. If 'topcover' is enabled, a mirrored set of shorter pocket blocks is generated on the negative X-axis using a coordinate offset.
